description: This file defines the Controller class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including nested classes for configuration and subsystem data, as well as notification handling. It declares interfaces for plugin lifecycle, web processing, and system control, with methods for initialization, configuration, and subsystem management.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main plugin controller class implementing multiple plugin and system management interfaces, handling plugin lifecycle, web requests, configuration, and subsystem notifications.

classes.name: Controller::SubsystemsData
classes.description: JSON container class representing subsystem data with 'subsystem' and 'active' fields.

classes.name: Controller::Config
classes.description: Configuration class containing probe settings, resumes, subsystems, and UI flag.

classes.name: Controller::Config::ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class within Config for probe-specific settings like TTL and node address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles delete requests for plugin resources.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts device discovery with specified TTL.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method call.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method call with parameters.

methods.name: Callstack
methods.description: Gets call stack data for a thread.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a base callsign.
